rows.note: This is the usual Cantonese term in everyday grammar talk and the all-purpose choice.

example.english: This lesson discusses first person; “I” in the example sentence refers to the person speaking.
example.traditional: 呢課講第一身，例句入面嘅「我」就係講緊個講嘢嘅人。
example.jyutping: ne1 fo3 gong2 dai6 jat1 san1 lai6 geoi3 jap6 min6 ge3 ngo5 zau6 hai6 gong2 gan2 go3 gong2 je5 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this more formal term in textbooks, linguistic writing, or careful explanations.

example.english: The grammar book classifies “we” as first person because it represents the speaker.
example.traditional: 語法書將「我哋」歸入第一人稱，因為佢代表講者。
example.jyutping: jyu5 faat3 syu1 zoeng1 ngo5 dei6 gwai1 jap6 dai6 jat1 jan4 cing1 jan1 wai6 keoi5 doi6 biu2 gong2 ze2
